title: docs(ui): cut ROADMAP.md to a pointer, delete the console-streamlining summary, rename the app-shell extraction guide
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D8qAi6V5b7pkuny9oUKDyVw)_

Part of #25919. This is PR 1 of the ruled workload (ruling 6407900763, item 3, housekeeping), minus the `ui/AGENTS.md` lines. #25919 remains open for PR 2, the `ui/AGENTS.md` restructure.

## What changed

- `ui/ROADMAP.md`: 1,899 lines cut to a 20-line pointer file. The old text stopped at v3.3.2 (May 2026) and claimed 80 Storybook stories; there is no `.storybook` anywhere in the tree. The pointer names where plans live now: issues and their `area:*` / `priority:*` labels, milestones and `target:*`, the platform `ROADMAP.md` and `NORTH-STAR.md`, the changelogs, and the ADRs. It also states that ADR numbers are allocated in the ObjectStack repository's `docs/adr`.
- `ui/docs/CONSOLE-STREAMLINING-SUMMARY.md`: deleted. It was a one-off session summary that duplicated the architecture guide.
- `ui/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` renamed to `ui/docs/app-shell-extraction-guide.md`, content unchanged. It is the 2026-04 app-shell extraction guide, not an architecture overview; the current overview is `content/docs/guide/architecture-overview.md`. Readers that follow the new name: the real-tree pin in `check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts`, the four `reads` entries in `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (the deleted file's entries removed), and the `setup.sh` hint, which now points at the architecture overview.

## Acceptance notes

- **`SCAN_ROOTS` row for `ROADMAP.md` kept, against the ruling's wording.** The ruling says to drop it, but `check-doc-links.test.ts` holds the invariant "scans EVERY tracked root-level markdown file". `ROADMAP.md` stays a tracked root file, so dropping its row would turn that test red. Keeping it is also the stricter reading: the pointer file's links stay checked. The row could only go if the file were deleted.
- **`.github/prompts/`** is already absent under `ui/` on `main`. Nothing to delete.
- **`ui/docs/adr/README.md` is not in this PR.** `ui/docs/adr/**` is on the governed surface, so it would make this PR Tier H and need contract review. It rides PR 2. The fact it would state, that ADR numbers come from objectstack, is in the pointer file meanwhile.
- **Dependabot item dropped with a reading.** `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` is dead: GitHub reads only the repository-root `.github`. The live root config has a `github-actions` entry with no `groups:` key, and no test pins the `changesets/action` SHA (the card's `changeset-release-action-ref-pin.test.ts` does not exist on `main`). The collision the card describes cannot happen today.
- **Left on purpose:** comments in `check-doc-expression-carriage.mjs` and its test that tell the history of `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (the ruling says existing comments are not swept), and the synthetic `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` fixtures in `check-doc-links.test.ts`, which build their own tree. The published `ui/apps/console/README.md` still calls the roadmap "the Console phases and their status". It was not edited, because a shipped-file change would owe a changeset for the whole fixed group.
- **No changeset (`skip-changeset`).** No package's `files[]` content changes: `ui/ROADMAP.md` and `ui/docs/**` belong to no package, and `ui/scripts/**` is private tooling.

## Verification (head 29ac985a)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` in `ui/` on `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-snippet-types`, `markdown-test-inputs`, `cross-file-line-citation-census` and `check-doc-expression-carriage` tests: Test Files 5 passed, Tests 377 passed (after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, because the carriage test imports the built spec).
- `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` (in `ui/`): exit 0, "Links are valid across 17 scan roots".
- `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` (in `ui/`): exit 0, "114 candidate test files, all adjudicated; 80 declared entries, all present".
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 22 commands; every one ran with exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 18 derived families accounted for, 0 NOT MEASURED.
- `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: pass.
